A very safe and somewhat peaceful place to sleep, except for the constant din of emergency vehicle sirens always roaming nearby in the background.

This community does not yet understand the unsettling effects of sound pollution.

It is as if the population is living in a continual state of emergency.

More advanced communities in the nation provide training to emergency vehicle operators teaching how the siren does not to be continually blaring to warn and clear areas of congestion.

Emergency vehicle operators here may just have well been ordered to sound their alerts as they do to keep the local populace in fear and under control.

The sirens they use are so loud, soon someone will bring suit against the government for hearing damage, or they will require pedestrians to begin wearing hearing protective devices.
